Soul Harvest (innate)
+%count% Ghost per creature killed
new-horizons.creature.soulHarvest.help: Soul Harvest (innate): Each eligible enemy creature killed by this stack's physical attack or retaliation adds %count% temporary Ghost. Partial casualties count; destroying the whole enemy stack is not required. Growth lasts only for this battle. Clones and summoned stacks cannot gain or provide growth. Suppressed creature abilities and temporary battle forms prevent growth. Killing resurrected creatures can grant growth again. Extra Ghosts never join the army after battle.
new-horizons.creature.freezingTouch.help: Freezing Touch: each successful melee attack or retaliation has a %chance%% chance, rolled once after damage, to inflict physical Frozen. Frozen prevents retaliation and forfeits the next normal Creature Activation, then thaws. Extra activations cannot thaw it. A subsequent ordinary physical creature attack deals +%bonus%% final damage and Shatters the ice, without retaliation. Direct magical damage breaks the ice without this bonus. Cure clears Frozen; ordinary Dispel does not. Cannot stack or refresh; at most one successful application per recipient per round, even after cleansing.
new-horizons.combat.frozen.label: Frozen
new-horizons.combat.frozen.tooltip: %label%: physical ice encasement. Cannot retaliate. The next normal Creature Activation is forfeited, then the ice thaws; extra activations cannot thaw it. The next ordinary physical creature attack deals +%bonus%% final damage and Shatters the ice, without retaliation. Direct magical damage breaks the ice without this bonus. Cure removes it; ordinary Dispel does not. Cannot refresh or stack; at most one application per round, even after cleansing.
new-horizons.combat.frozen.queue: Frozen: incapacitated. The next normal Creature Activation is forfeited, then thaws. Extra activations do not thaw the ice.

new-horizons.combat.frozen.shatter: The ice around %creature% Shatters after the physical hit; no retaliation.

new-horizons.heroSpecialty.petrifyingBlo: The first damaging enemy melee hit each round triggers an ordinary petrification attempt on the attacker.

Once per round for each Basilisk or Greater Basilisk stack, the first enemy physical melee hit that deals damage triggers an ordinary petrification attempt on the attacker. The attempt is spent even if the roll fails or the attacker is immune.

new-horizons.spellbook.targetUnknown: Potential effect before recipient limits or bonuses. No random proc is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.beforeDefenses: Potential damage before target defenses, immunities and recipient-dependent effects. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.followupBeforeTar: Potential follow-up damage before target defenses and target-dependent Split Focus or Focused Pairing. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.poisonTicks: Physical damage on the next three normal Creature Activations: the first tick is shown; the second deals 150% and the third 200%, each rounded down. No random proc is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.holyArmorRecipien: Current caster potential before any recipient-specific Crown and Altar bonus. The configured fixed reduction is not scaled.
new-horizons.spellbook.hexTrigger: Each eligible physical hit triggers the shown captured flat damage plus this share of actual damage. No random proc is assumed; recipient defenses and trigger eligibility remain separate.
new-horizons.spellbook.plagueSnapshot: Initial raw Plague tick snapshot before recipient effects or a random proc. Later ticks and child infections reuse this captured value; Warcasting and Empower are not added to this authored snapshot.
new-horizons.spellbook.regenerationRecov: This share of damage suffered by surviving creatures can be recovered at the start of their next activation, limited to wounds; casualties are not restored.
new-horizons.spellbook.minePlacement: Shown damage is per mine before recipient defenses or a random proc. Placement can be limited by legal empty ground hexes.
new-horizons.spellbook.reanimateRecipien: Current pool before the recipient is selected. It first repairs surviving wounds; Reanimator increases only the remaining casualty pool. Actual restored creatures depend on recipient wounds and casualty capacity.
new-horizons.spellbook.phantomRecipient: Caster-derived Integrity fraction shown to hundredths of a percent using the shared 10,000-HP reference. The chosen source stack supplies current HP; its actual Integrity pool is rounded down after scaling.
new-horizons.spellbook.doomRecipient: Reduces physical attack damage and Speed by the shown amount. Initiative changes only for a recipient with an explicit Initiative base; unknown target protections are not assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.recipientTierSpec: Current caster magnitude before recipient-tier specialty bonuses. Known flat and fixed caster overrides are already included; target attributes are not assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.stormCounts: Per-stack damage varies with the number of selected stacks, up to the spell's configured maximum. Actual legal counts depend on eligible targets. Range is before target defenses; no random proc is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.summonPlacement: Summoned HP pool. Actual creature count depends on the summoned creature's maximum HP, and placement must be legal.
new-horizons.spellbook.soulChainRecipien: Echo rate from the current hero. Actual damage depends on damage dealt to linked secondary stacks and the primary stack's defenses; no targets or random proc are assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.restorationRecipi: Current hero restoration pool before recipient-specific bonuses. Actual restored HP and casualties depend on the selected stack, its wounds, and spell-specific restoration rules.
new-horizons.spellbook.heavenlyGaleRecip: Current hero reduction of incoming physical projectile damage before recipient-specific Crown and Altar. Actual damage also depends on penetration, other defenses and the aggregate physical reduction cap; melee damage is unaffected.
new-horizons.spellbook.healthRate: Current caster damage rate before target defenses, rounded down to two decimal places. Actual HP damage is rounded for the selected stack; target-dependent specialties and defenses remain unknown.
new-horizons.spellbook.shadowGiftChoice: Range across the available sacrifice tiers. Actual tier and recipient HP cost are chosen when casting; Dark Gift reduces the sacrifice cost, not this offensive rate.
new-horizons.spellbook.naturesWrathRoute: First recipient potential before target defenses or missing-HP limits. Later hops attenuate through the captured route; actual recipients, defenses and wounds remain unknown.
new-horizons.spellbook.pandemoniumCount: Conditional damage at exactly one distinct debuff. Actual damage depends on the selected recipient's captured debuff count; the shared formula rounds the full aggregate once. No debuffs or recipients are inspected here.
new-horizons.spellbook.holyWrathRecipien: Lower value for an ordinary recipient; upper value for an undead or Inferno recipient. A recipient with both traits receives the multiplier once. Values are before recipient defenses.
new-horizons.spellbook.handOfFateSpill: Current primary damage before defenses. Spill is based on half the actual primary damage and the randomly selected recipient's defenses; no spill recipient or random outcome is predicted.
new-horizons.spellbook.soulReaperHealth: Current base damage plus the caster-adjusted missing-HP component rate. The combined amount is rounded by the actual caster damage stages, then recipient defenses and conditional execution apply. Unknown HP, execution and random procs are not assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.effect.purify: Remove up to %s effects per stack
new-horizons.spellbook.purifyChoices: Maximum selectable negative spell effects per eligible stack. Actual removable effects and recipients depend on the selected area; Purifier's automatic physical affliction removal remains separate.
new-horizons.spellbook.chaosShieldCap: Current stored magic reduction. The spell also protects against physical damage, whose aggregate reduction cap may limit its benefit; attacker penetration and other sources are resolved against the chosen recipient.
new-horizons.spellbook.divineReflectionD: Maximum end-of-round reflection before unknown recipient-specific Crown and Altar. The shared payout uses 30% of actual HP damage taken, caps that amount, then applies Retributionist. Actual incoming damage, recipient bonuses and defenses remain unknown.
new-horizons.spellbook.misfortuneChance: Multiplier on explicitly affected favorable random creature abilities, relative to their ordinary chance. Caster enchantment overrides are included; unknown recipient-tier specialty adjustments are not assumed. No ability or random outcome is predicted. Luck penalties and other effects remain in the full description.
new-horizons.spellbook.verdantPlacement: Current hero HP pool before distribution over the legal ring. The actual ring, creature counts and placement remain unknown.
new-horizons.spellbook.transfigureFootpr: Conditional HP values for one-hex and two-hex obstacles. Actual HP uses the selected obstacle's full footprint and the same whole-pool rounding; no obstacle or creature count is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.earthquakeSiege: Current siege mode: structural damage per chosen section and the maximum section count. Actual eligible sections depend on the chosen location; no Luck outcome is assumed.
new-horizons.spellbook.earthquakeMode: Outdoor damage before recipient defenses, with conditional siege section count. In a fortified battle the row switches to structural damage per section. No targets, structures or Luck outcomes are predicted.
new-horizons.spellbook.vinesShape: Damage per intersected enemy stack before recipient defenses, plus the loaded movement Speed modifier. Each stack is hit once; actual recipients depend on the selected connected hexes. Initiative is unchanged.
new-horizons.spellbook.compactNotation: Compact large or fractional values may be rounded down. Scientific notation 1.23e6 means 1,230,000; D/H denote damage/healing HP, L denotes missing HP, and h denotes obstacle hexes.
new-horizons.spellbook.lifeDrainHealing: Potential damage before target defenses, immunities and recipient-dependent effects. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed. Healing restores the shown percentage of actual damage dealt, rounded down and limited by the friendly recipient's wounds; it does not restore casualties. H denotes that healing percentage.
new-horizons.spellbook.lifeDrainFollowup: Potential follow-up damage before target defenses and target-dependent Split Focus or Focused Pairing. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed. Healing restores the shown percentage of actual damage dealt, rounded down and limited by the friendly recipient's wounds; it does not restore casualties. H denotes that healing percentage.
